purpose: Teach: 賠償/失業/暴力団/ヒトラー/文部省/王朝/満州/殺す

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦後の、本気で、絶対、賠償、絶対、政策、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on postwar reparation policies was remarkably thorough. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Steady eye contact. Slight pause before naming the specific topic, showing she's genuinely recalling the work. Genuine admiration without excess.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。世界恐慌期の、本気で、絶対、失業、絶対、問題、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to dig deep into the unemployment crisis during the Great Depression. I'm grateful for the chance to research it.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Quiet pride underneath the politeness. Speaking directly, not performing gratitude. A slight lift at the end—she means what she's saying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の、本気で、絶対、暴力団、絶対、対策、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you tackled yakuza control measures in the postwar period showed such breadth of vision. Really impressive work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational tone. Speaks as though seeing the scope of the research for the first time. Sincere admiration—the kind that comes from noticing something genuine, not offering routine praise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。第二次世界大戦の、本気で、絶対、ヒトラー、絶対、政権、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to understand how Hitler's regime actually consolidated power. It required deep historical research, and I'm thankful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Focused and direct. Speaks with the seriousness of someone who's lived with the material. No overselling—just stating what the work demanded and what she learned.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、文部省、絶対、教育政策、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The scope of your investigation into prewar education ministry policy was striking. You clearly did your homework.
lines.style: Calm, recognizing nod in the voice. Speaking as a teacher who's seen the difference between surface work and real engagement. Understated but unmistakable warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、王朝、絶対、政治史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I covered dynastic political history across ancient kingdoms, trying to understand the patterns. It took real work, and I'm appreciative.
lines.style: Even-toned, unflinching. Not rushing. Speaks as someone who's internalized the material. Modest without being self-deprecating.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、満州、絶対、開拓史、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your research into Manchurian settlement history during the prewar period—that was sophisticated work. I have to say, I'm impressed.
lines.style: Reflective pause before the topic. Speaks slowly, appreciatively, as though turning over the work in her mind. Sincere, substantive praise. A slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、王朝が、絶対、政敵を、絶対、殺す、絶対、事例、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Historically, there are countless examples of dynasties eliminating political rivals. That's what I focused on—the patterns and cases. It was demanding work, and I'm grateful.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching directness. Speaking matter-of-factly about difficult material. No flinching or softening. Calm, serious, and grounded in the work itself.
